answer: Problem: cheap keys let one operator flood attest slots in one epoch. Mechanism: full weight needs a 28h 4-stop voyage. At 0/9/18/28h it posts a 48-byte signed waypoint chaining prior hash. After stop 1 it locks 4,800 POA for 19h in an oasis hold, released if all 4 are on time. After stop 2 a zephyr check of 6 probes needs delay spread >=40ms. Until final, weight is 0.20 and cannot seal. Cost: 4,800 POA locked 19h plus 28h delay. Verification: peers recompute the waypoint chain. Failure: a late stop slashes 15% (720 POA) and restarts; two misses in 10d burn the rest and bar it 5 epochs.
